# Sealed Storage

> Encrypt files in the browser with Seal (threshold encryption with on-chain access policies: time lock or holding an Access Gate pass) and store them on Walrus. Nothing we operate can decrypt your data.

Address: https://sui-sealed-storage.meddleware.co.uk

## Documentation

- [User guide](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/sealed-storage/)
- [Policies](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/sealed-storage/policies)
- [Developer integration](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/sealed-storage/integration)
